The work done by the gas in an adiabatic frictionless process is given by \( W = -\Delta U = -\int_{T_1}^{T_2} C_v \, dT \). For an ideal gas, \( C_v = C_p - R \), with \( R = \frac{1545}{778 \times 34.0} \approx 0.05841 \, \text{Btu/(lb·°R)} \). Using \( C_p = 0.212 + 0.000059T \) (T in °R) and converting temperatures to Rankine (200°F = 659.67°R, 300°F = 759.67°R), the integral yields approximately \(-19.55 \, \text{Btu/lb}\).

ANSWER: A
